title: FloorCirculation
description: Route reservations in the blueprint's XZ coordinate frame, made before furnishing. Architecture is sampled at cellSize with body-radius wall erosion and inset door throats. Grounded furniture, including chairs, stays outside the full bodyWidth swept routes. This is not a continuous architecture collision or accessibility certificate; elevated objects and NPC seat-use approaches are outside this output.

minimumDoorWidth.description: Smallest published room door or 1 m stair channel width on this floor, independent of the body width.

origin.description: Shared circulation route start in the floor spine, not the grid origin.

source.description: Room, door, stair or elevator ID.

maxDisplacement.description: Approaches stay within this radius of their intended point. Room-door approaches also stay in their owning room; core approaches have no room constraint. Null permits a clipped room hub to move only within that room.
